content:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: GPU pool 'inference-gpu-prod' experiencing high pending pods and throttling. HPA showing 'no metrics' for 12m. Severity P1. Root trace hint: metrics-adapter 504 to prometheus.

sara (oncall): I'm on call. Seeing sudden queue growth and 429 bursts for public endpoints. Which HPA metric is failing?

ben (infra): HPA configured to use external metric `external/redwood/gpu_utilization`. Adapter logs show repeated 504s to prometheus at ~21:02 UTC; adapter stopped returning valid metrics, HPA couldn't compute replicas.

anya (ml-oncall): Model hotlist: v2-large and a few rerank endpoints. KV cache hit dropped, causing more GPU work. If autoscale stalls, we hit quota quickly.

mike (sre): k8s events show `FailedCreate` for new GPU nodes due to cloud quota `nvidia-gpu` limit reached. So even if HPA wanted to scale, cloud refused.

support-agent: CS reports multiple customers with elevated latencies and timeouts; top complaint from Acme who saw 500s. Triage message sent.

ben (infra): Plan: 1) restart metrics-adapter to restore metrics 2) mitigate Prometheus load by dropping noisy exporter metrics 3) manual mitigations: route low-priority traffic to CPU pool, promote quantized model variants.

sara (oncall): Start with traffic shaping. I'll implement a temporary ingress rule to throttle free-tier and low-priority customers. Also prepare to drain low-priority GPU nodes to reclaim capacity.

infra-bot: Applying temp-rate-limit config to ingress.

ben (infra): Restarting adapter `kubectl -n monitoring rollout restart deployment/custom-metrics-adapter`. Adapter came back but reported sparse samples for last 8m; Prometheus TSDB shows ingestion backlog.

mike (sre): Opened cloud ticket CP-8552 for GPU quota bump. Ops-lead looped. If quota not available soon, we need to force-reschedule to CPU.

ops-lead: If provider can't provision nodes in <20m, proceed with drain and reschedule plan. Prioritize customers on paid tiers for reclaimed GPUs.

sara (oncall): Draining node gpu-node-11 to reclaim 3 GPUs: `kubectl drain node/gpu-node-11 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=30`.

infra-bot: Node gpu-node-11 cordoned, eviction started. Some pods stuck due to local volumes.

anya (ml-oncall): Force-evict after checkpoint sync. Running `rsync -av /mnt/checkpoints s3://redwood-temp/` now.

ben (infra): Adapter started returning metrics at 21:16 UTC and HPA computed desired 20 replicas from 12. But cloud refused scale due to quota. HPA reports `Failed to create pod` events.

sara (oncall): Manual scale attempt to reclaim capacity within quota: `kubectl scale deployment/inference-gpu --replicas=16`. Attempting to schedule within existing nodes.

mike (sre): Manual scale succeeded; pods scheduled, but some pending until node evictions finish. 429s persist during the ramp.

support-agent: Updated Acme: "We're throttling low-priority traffic and scaling within current capacity. We'll keep you posted." Customer acknowledged.

ben (infra): Found root cause for adapter overload: a custom exporter `edge-debug-exporter` went into a crashloop and emitted 8M spike samples causing Prometheus ingestion pressure and adapter timeouts. Deployed a filter to drop `edge.debug_samples` metric. Restarted exporter.

infra-bot: edge-debug-exporter restarted and metric filter applied to Prometheus relabel configs.

anya (ml-oncall): After traffic shift and promoting quantized variant for bulk endpoints, queue length fell and KV hit recovered to ~70%. Latency trending back toward SLOs.

incident-bot: Metrics summary: GPU pool utilization down from 96% to 74% after manual actions. HPA resumed using custom metric at 21:35 UTC. Queue growth reduced from 4x to 1.1x baseline.

sara (oncall): Good containment. Next steps: add HPA fallback to CPU resource metric so autoscaling keeps functioning if adapter goes flaky. Ben, please prepare patch.

ben (infra): Patching HPA to include CPU fallback: `kubectl patch hpa inference-hpa -p '{"spec":{"metrics":[{"type":"External","external":{"metric":{"name":"custom/gpu_utilization"},"target":{"type":"AverageValue","averageValue":"70"}}},{"type":"Resource","resource":{"name":"cpu","target":{"type":"Utilization","averageUtilization":80}}}]}}'`

mike (sre): Also adding an alert: if metrics-adapter 5xx rate >10% for 5m, page infra and engage autoscale-fallback runbook.

ops-lead: We'll open RCA items: 1) noisy exporter allowed to flood ingestion 2) metrics-adapter had no circuit breaker 3) no autoscaler fallback led to stalled recovery 4) quota policy didn't reserve burst headroom.

sara (oncall): Opening follow-ups: - CS refunds evaluation - add autoscale fallback & HPA policy - adapter rate-limits/circuit-breaker INFRA tickets - quota reserve plan with cloud ops

support-agent: CS ticket CS-1310 created for Acme and two other impacted customers; draft customer note pending.

anya (ml-oncall): Proposing automatic model downgrade to quantized variant when GPU queue > 2 or GPU util > 85% for 2m. Will add as a medium-term automation.

ben (infra): Creating INFRA-460 (adapter rate-limits), INFRA-461 (HPA fallback), INFRA-462 (quota burst reservation).

incident-bot: Incident mitigated and being closed. Please file a blameless postmortem within 48h and tag #incidents #infra #ml.

sara (oncall): Thanks team — closing the live thread. Will compile timeline and impact list for postmortem.

mike (sre): Collecting Prometheus samples and exporter logs for 20:50-21:40 window and sanitizing data.

ops-lead: Follow-up sync scheduled tomorrow to prioritise infra work and cloud quota discussion.

sara (oncall): One-line timeline: exporter crashloop -> prometheus ingestion spike -> metrics-adapter timeouts -> HPA stalled -> GPUs exhausted -> manual drain + traffic shaping + quantized promotion -> exporter fix + adapter restart -> HPA recovered -> mitigated.

support-agent: I'll circulate the post-incident customer communication draft once CS-1310 is updated.

incident-bot: Reminder: attach logs, timeline, and impact table to the postmortem issue."
